name: Túnel d'Envalira toll
law: Túnel d'Envalira's fares per passage, either way, set under its concession from the Government of Andorra and published by the concessionaire Túnel d'Envalira S.A.U.: category 3 (heavy vehicles over 3 m high or over 3.5 t, two axles) EUR 16.30, category 4 (more than two axles) EUR 20.30. The dangerous goods supplement isn't modelled. The page gives no date: valid_from is the day it was first read.
tolled_roads: The Túnel d'Envalira (CG-2, Grau Roig–Pas de la Casa), charged at its toll plaza either way.
